interval.sidedness: one-sided bounds from the two-sided 90% percentile interval
interval.defense_seed_variation: reported separately as per-seed table; seeds are refit replicates over shared assessment units
interval.max_statistics: re-maximise worst-class / worst-pair inside each bootstrap replicate

support.pair_rule: both classes >= min_pair_n in attacker_fit and assessment

roles.defense_fit: historical rows that entered any fitted parameter; fixed by artifact
roles.pool: rows outside defense_fit (PCRL v2: test split; dg-on-PCRL-R4 cells: PCRL val+test, never read by dg)
roles.secondary_overlap_arm: attacker_fit = defense_fit rows; label defense_fit_overlap=true; never pooled
roles.alignment_assertion: all surfaces and recipes scored on identical assessment unit IDs

linear_floor.rule: drop covariance directions with eigenvalue < rel * largest

metrics.definition: method's own statistic exactly as defined (PCRL: in-sample pooled one-hot ridge R2, reg 1e-6 on unnormalised centred Gram, clamp 0, pass < 0.05)
1 - sum||z - zhat||^2 / sum||z - zbar_fit||^2 over one-hot columns; zhat from R02 fit on attacker_fit; intercepts/means from attacker_fit
1 - SSE(prob vs one-hot) / SSE(prior from attacker_fit)
prior log-loss (attacker_fit frequencies) minus model log-loss
mean OvR AUC over supported classes
max over supported classes of OvR AUC
max over supported pairs (j,k) of AUC on rows of classes j,k with score p_j/(p_j+p_k)
lambda_max(S_YY^-1/2 S_YZ (S_ZZ + eps I)^-1 S_ZY S_YY^-1/2), Y = centred one-hot with one class dropped, eps = 1e-6 tr(S_ZZ)/d; equals max linear-contrast R2
metrics.rows: in-sample (definitional) and held-out (directions on attacker_fit, correlation on assessment)
metrics.role: contrast diagnostic; not interchangeable with max pair AUC

metrics.definition: PCRL max per-class OvR ridge R2 (historical)

surfaces.definition: released representation exactly as the method releases it (deterministic or one fresh draw)
declared task-output object of the frozen head: hard_label | calibrated_score | logit_vector (declared per cell in lock)
both, only where the release contract gives both to the same recipient

attackers.model: sklearn LogisticRegression(multinomial, lbfgs, max_iter=5000) after StandardScaler fit on attacker_fit
affine one-hot least squares with numerical floor and relative ridge lambda = rho * tr(S)/d; means from attacker_fit
sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier (early stopping on internal split of attacker_fit)
sklearn MLPClassifier, 2 hidden layers, StandardScaler, early_stopping (internal split of attacker_fit)
multinomial LR on one-hot true task label + empirical frequency table

attackers.budget: 5 configs; nested slate includes R01, R06L
38 configs; nested slate includes R03, R04, R06N

attackers.model: R06N on the untreated model's output object
class-conditional Gaussian LRT fit on clean population vectors + known noise covariance (stored dg Tier 2; A4)
class-conditional Gaussian LRT fit on noised releases with known noise covariance subtracted (A2)
R03 + R04 trained on releases simulated by applying the frozen encoder + frozen fitted defense to the attacker's own labelled population (K=8 draws for stochastic channels)
attackers.budget: 38 configs (20 R03 + 18 R04); 3 seeds; <= 1 CPU core-hour per cell-arm
attackers.requires: stored fitted defense parameters; else NE (defense_parameters_not_stored)

attackers.model: average of N independent releases per target, then R11-selected model (or LRT with sigma/sqrt(N))
attackers.applies_to: contracts issuing fresh noise per query; persistent token -> N=1; deterministic -> not applicable

attackers.model: R01 + R03 on releases projected onto span(Q) and its complement (Q known)
R01/R03/R04 on concatenated coalition views with nested single/ancestor/prior predictors

decision_rule.note: failure to establish recovery is not evidence of absence; 'established below' is always qualified by recipe and access

category_mapping.C1: native check fails as the method defines it
category_mapping.C2: native passes AND R02 heldout_linear_r2 established above tau
category_mapping.C3: native passes AND any out-of-scope recipe established above its bar
category_mapping.C4: verified assumptions of a population guarantee AND its bound established exceeded
category_mapping.C5: NE or all relevant bounds unresolved

decomposition_factorial.isolates: surface vs F2/F4; references R05, R08

multiplicity.adjustment: Holm across all primary tests (endpoint x cell x arm); bootstrap p-values
multiplicity.secondary: unadjusted intervals, labelled exploratory; bars 0.52/0.60 and tau != 0.05 are sensitivity
multiplicity.intersection_union: multi-clause conclusions reported as IU decisions; k-of-m is not partial confirmation

utility.rows: assessment rows of the same cell

kinds.U1: frozen deployed head on assessment rows; label rows that entered head/defense fitting
kinds.U2: independent probe family (R01-style LR + R04-style MLP) fit on attacker_fit, selected on attacker_val
kinds.U3: retrospective selection label for operating points chosen after inspection

utility.frontier_rule: only among arms with overlapping utility CIs or within 1pp margin; collapsed/constant releases flagged, never passes

multi_purpose.permission_table: deny-by-default; for frozen PCRL artifacts the table each model was trained under (pcrl/data/*.py disallowed lists), copied into the lock
multi_purpose.coalition_targets: attributes disallowed to every coalition member only

exposure.amendments_file: AMENDMENTS.md (UTC time, change, reason, results seen?)
